description: BodyBinary decodes its \xHH escapes into raw bytes, with a parameter value sent verbatim (its backslash is not an escape); BodyFilePath sends the archived file's bytes; BodyUnicode is sent as UTF-16LE without a byte-order mark.
source: VuGen 26.1 Function Reference: web_custom_request (BodyBinary \xHH escapes, BodyUnicode UTF-16LE, BodyFilePath).
